blueprint.executive_summary: Automated Test Project is designed as an intelligent, automated digital platform specifically tailored to solve manual workflow friction for Internal Staff & Academic Faculty. The platform centralizes data operations, eliminates redundant paperwork, and enforces data accuracy and compliance with sub-second responsiveness.
blueprint.problem_statement: Currently, stakeholders rely on disjointed spreadsheets, manual data compilation, and error-prone physical paperwork. This leads to operational bottlenecks, delayed reports, and an estimated 10-15 wasted hours per staff member every week.
project_goals: Automate end-to-end data processing for Automated Test Project
Enable high-velocity document export in compliant PDF, Word, and Excel formats
Provide auditable, role-based security ensuring sensitive student and organizational records remain protected
Reduce report compilation latency from days to under 10 seconds

confirmed_functional_requirements.description: Secure sign-in with JWT, password hashing, and authorization guards.

confirmed_functional_requirements.title: Automated Document Rendering Engine
confirmed_functional_requirements.description: Generate print-ready PDFs and editable Word documents with standardized academic templates.

confirmed_functional_requirements.title: Spreadsheet Ingestion & Validation Pipeline
confirmed_functional_requirements.description: Parse Excel/CSV uploads with instant cell-level validation and mismatch alerts.

confirmed_functional_requirements.title: Interactive Analytics & Insights Dashboard
confirmed_functional_requirements.description: Real-time key performance indicators, pass rates, and trend visualization.

user_roles_and_permissions.permissions: Manage users, configure academic templates, view audit logs, wipe/restore data
Upload marks, generate question papers, issue certificates, export reports
View personal grades, download validated certificates, verify QR codes

page_by_page_ui_plan.components: Email/password form, SSO button, Password recovery, Role preview
Recent activities, quick action launchpad, system status cards, pending approvals
File upload dropzone, live template previewer, export toolbar (PDF/DOCX/Excel)
Interactive charts, pass percentage distribution, arrear identification table
User role management, question templates editor, security & audit trail viewer

steps: Staff signs into the portal using college credentials
Navigates to Results Analysis module and uploads departmental marks spreadsheet (.xlsx)
Engine parses rows, validates student register numbers, and computes averages and pass percentages
Staff reviews visual distribution chart, flags borderline scores, and clicks 'Generate Report'
Backend renders validated PDF and Excel reports with institutional headers

detailed_user_journeys.journey: Event Certificate Generation & QR Verification Flow
steps: Coordinator creates event and uploads participant attendance roster
Selects approved certificate template and verifies signature metadata
Clicks 'Bulk Generate Certificates' -> backend renders unique PDFs with cryptographically signed QR codes
Third-party verifier scans the QR code and is directed to the public verification endpoint showing official validation

api_requirements.purpose: Authenticate user and issue JWT bearer token
List user projects with status and completion percentage
Create new project draft with template binding
Generate real binary export (PDF, Word, CSV, Markdown, JSON)

ai_architecture.deterministic_boundary: Critical business logic, marks calculations, and database mutations are 100% deterministic code.
ai_architecture.generative_boundary: Question formulation, Bloom's taxonomy suggestions, and natural-language summaries leverage LLMs with strict JSON schema validation.
ai_architecture.fallback_mechanism: If external AI API is unreachable, system gracefully falls back to deterministic template rules without interrupting user workflows.

security_requirements: Password hashing using industry-standard bcrypt with salt
JWT tokens signed with HS256 and configurable expiration
Server-side authorization guards preventing unauthorized tenant access
Sanitization of all incoming filenames and uploaded document streams
Audit trail tracking all export and project administrative operations
integration_requirements: RESTful JSON API with OpenAPI (Swagger) documentation
Standard MIME-type file streaming for PDF, Word, and Excel downloads
Pluggable LLM endpoints (OpenAI / Gemini / Anthropic / Local Ollama)

validation_rules.rule: Strip control characters, enforce max lengths, escape HTML entities
Verify file extension (.xlsx, .csv), check magic bytes, enforce max file size of 25MB
Enforce type constraints (e.g. integer for numeric questions, list for multi-select)

error_handling_strategy: Unified HTTP exception handler with standardized error JSON schemas
Safe database rollback on transaction failure
Graceful UI toast notifications for network timeouts or validation alerts

testing_strategy.scope: Engine rules, condition evaluation, contradiction detection, password hashing
FastAPI endpoints, project CRUD, response autosave, blueprint generation
Verifying PDF, DOCX, CSV, and JSON generators create valid binary files on disk
Full user walkthrough from idea creation to blueprint export

mvp_scope: Project creation with natural-language idea extraction
Adaptive conditional questionnaire with live auto-save
Contradiction detection and missing requirement alerts
Real backend file exports (PDF, DOCX, Markdown, JSON, CSV)

future_development_phases.title: Multi-Tenant Cloud Sync & Realtime Collaboration
future_development_phases.scope: WebSockets for concurrent multi-user editing and institutional SSO integrations.

future_development_phases.title: Automated Code Scaffolding
future_development_phases.scope: One-click export of starter codebases (FastAPI backend + React frontend) directly from the generated blueprint.

acceptance_criteria: User can input a project idea in English or Tamil-English transliteration and have it auto-structured
Questions adapt in real time to previous selections without page reloads
Irrelevant questions are automatically omitted from the active flow
Auto-save preserves every answer with visual confirmation
Clicking export generates real downloadable PDF, DOCX, Markdown, JSON, and CSV files
The entire platform runs responsively across mobile and desktop viewports

assumptions_requiring_approval.statement: The client institution has existing email infrastructure for automated notifications.
